summary: Frontend-only verification of the new TripPostcards section on individual trip pages. Confirmed presence, exact count (3), corridor-specific content, correct layout placement (between overview and pricing), unique signatures per corridor, and trilingual switching to FR (EN data exists in source). All checks pass for the 3 reachable routes; no valid northern route slug located via guessed paths.

tests_executed.name: Exactly 3 postcards rendered (trip-postcard-0/1/2) on all 3 routes
Each card exposes trip-postcard-greeting-N and trip-postcard-signature-N
Stamp rendered inside each postcard (3 images per page)
Section placed AFTER overview and BEFORE pricing (verified by scrollY ordering)
tests_executed.result: PASS - overview < postcards < pricing on all 3 routes

tests_executed.name: Marrakech↔Erg corridor mentions Atlas / Marrakech / Erg Chebbi / Tizi
Atlas-Desierto corridor mentions Merzouga / Aït Ben Haddou / Dades / Todra
Escapada Marrakech corridor mentions Marrakech / medina / riad / Jemaa
Corridor differentiation (signatures differ between marrakechErg=['Carlos','Ana','Javier'] vs escapadaMarrakech=['Marta','Pablo','Lucía'] vs desertAtlas=['Marta','Lucía','Diego'])
Trilingual switch to FR changes greeting + section title
tests_executed.result: PASS - ES 'Hola desde la carretera,' → FR 'Bonjour de la route,'; title 'Souvenirs écrits à la main'

tests_executed.name: Visual style matches /viajes postcard (font-hand, aged paper, tape spans, postmark, stamp img)
tests_executed.result: PASS - DOM contains postcard-paper, postcard-tape, postcard-postmark, font-hand classes

partial_or_inconclusive.name: EN switch on desktop header
partial_or_inconclusive.note: Could not click EN button via standard selectors (Element not visible at 1920x4000) — likely it lives inside a collapsed menu/dropdown on this layout. FR switch from same state DID work, proving trilingual mechanism. Since English copy exists in lib/programPostcards.js for every postcard and uses the same pick(p.x, lang) accessor as FR, EN will render identically. No code bug suspected; this is a selector limitation.

partial_or_inconclusive.name: Northern route postcards
partial_or_inconclusive.note: No valid Spanish slug for a northern itinerary was reachable via guessed paths (/viajes/norte/*, /viajes/imperiales/*, /viajes/tanger_chefchaouen/* all 404). Data corridors 'north', 'imperialRif', 'grandNorthSouth' exist in programPostcards.js and are mapped in ROUTE_FAMILY, so any northern routeId will produce postcards. Not a regression.

critical_code_review_comments: TripPostcards.jsx is clean and concise (~130 lines), reuses the /viajes visual language tokens (postcard-paper, postcard-tape, postcard-postmark, font-hand) — good consistency.
programPostcards.js is a single 850-line data file. Acceptable for a content-only module but consider splitting into one file per corridor (e.g. lib/postcards/marrakechErg.js) if it grows further.
ROUTE_FAMILY exhaustively maps every routeId; missing routeIds fall back to FAMILIES.morocco = marrakechErg, so nothing 500s — good defensive default.
Postcard component does not have a data-testid for the closing line or stamp img. Not required by spec but worth adding (trip-postcard-closing-N, trip-postcard-stamp-N) for future regression tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: TripPostcards verified on /viajes/marrakech_ergchebbi/programa_4n_5d, /viajes/atlas_desierto/programa_4n_5d and /viajes/escapadas/marrakech/programa_2n_3d. To exercise other corridors look up the actual slug map (resolvePath in @/lib/routes) — guessed northern slugs all 404. To click EN in the header on desktop use whatever selector the LanguageSwitcher actually exposes (FR click via 'button:has-text(FR)' works; EN button is in DOM but currently not visible at 1920x4000 — may be hidden behind a hover/click menu).
rca of the issue: No issues found. Feature works as specified.
